creatures.name: Bubbleshell
creatures.description: A shy turtle-like creature that shoots pressurised water from its shell vents.

creatures.name: Leafroot
creatures.description: A stout plant creature whose roots double as powerful whips.

creatures.name: Flarepounce
creatures.description: A swift fox-like creature that ignites its tail before every pounce.

creatures.name: Sparkpup
creatures.description: A scrappy electric pup that crackles with static whenever it gets excited.

creatures.name: Pebblebug
creatures.description: A beetle-like creature that hides under rocks and launches pebbles at intruders.

creatures.name: Windfuzz
creatures.description: A fluffy bird creature that rides updrafts and drops seeds like tiny bombs.

creatures.name: Thornmole
creatures.description: A burrowing mole covered in sharp thorns. Tunnels up beneath unsuspecting travellers.

creatures.name: Glowgrub
creatures.description: A bioluminescent larva that flashes blinding light when threatened.

creatures.name: Frostbite
creatures.description: A crystalline wolf whose fangs flash blue before delivering a freezing bite.

creatures.name: Cragback
creatures.description: A slow tortoise whose shell is made of compressed mountain granite.

creatures.name: Shiverspark
creatures.description: A jagged electric lizard that slides across icy surfaces at terrifying speed.

creatures.name: Glaciwing
creatures.description: A moth-like creature with frost-dusted wings that scatter ice powder mid-flight.

creatures.name: Boulderfist
creatures.description: A knuckle-dragging brute that punches boulders for fun. Its fists are harder than steel.

creatures.name: Embershard
creatures.description: A volcanic gecko that sheds flaming scales as armour chips off during battle.
